why: The 57 local no-rate entries whose websites showed no booking link in the static scan (remaining_2026-10-11.json bucket no_rate_public minus the leads file). Only their pages' $ lines had ever been read.
method: Every website rendered in the one browser for $ lines and rate/booking links; rate links, fee PDFs, county fee schedules, booking engines (Checkfront, MotoPress) and council records followed; search for operator pages where our link was a directory.
result: 25 priced (111 -> 86 unpriced); 14 website links fixed or added; 1 seven-night summer minimum marked for AWH (Nickerson Beach); 1 whole-park-only reservation flagged (Old Wadena); 32 not priced, reason under outcome.
